name: HCWG OC+ Meeting
description: Our regular working group OC+ meeting. This meeting is typically to go over updates, planning, and for the OC and any interested members to align on next steps for the Working Group. If you are interested in joining and chatting with the OC about something, please reach out to healthcare@socialists.nyc to be added to the schedule. We ask that you try to reach out to us at least 3 days prior to the meeting so that we can ensure you are added to the agenda and we keep the timing of the entire meeting to be no longer than 1.5 hours.
